title: [SEP-7] DM routing relies on per-DID "relay hints" that identity records are forbidden to carry
description: Review finding SEP-7: DM routing relies on per-DID "relay hints" that identity records are forbidden to carry (lens SEP). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:151, 153; vs spec/02-identity.md:37, 302. Fix: The contradiction is as described. The finding's fix assumes a registration path for DMs that does not exist. 05:204 requires every announcement to carry a `billingSig` from a service that authenticates the requester "as a current member of the channel under Space state", but DMs have no Space (04:145), and no text says who registers or countersigns a DM chain. Fix: delete the relay-hint sentences at 04:151 and 04:153, carry the relay list in the Welcome (for example as a GroupContext extension), and specify DM chain registration and countersigning. Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: Relay-hint sentences gone from spec/04-access-control.md; DM relay list in identity host's ChannelAdmissionKey (spec/04-access-control.md §4.6 lines ~150-158, agora_admission_host extension); DM registration by identity host (spec/10-relays.md §10.5.3)
